behavior: Always creates and replaces the common 0x13eb430 service before the palette-item key branch.

For palette-item key components 0x510a95b and 0x40464100, configures the common service, initializes the -1 default service, and replaces all six freshly queried keyed services with add-reference, field store, and old-release ordering.

Calls the base palette layout dependency on every common-service path, retains palette_item at editor+0x6c through the observed field-assignment lifecycle, and invokes 0x005c51e0 with the editor as receiver while forwarding palette_item and owner/application context.

When 0x92df6fd8 is present, creates the page controller, binds it, initializes it, resolves the selected model from the base palette item receiver, then creates and binds the 0x3304221b and 0x3304221c layout resources.

Copies the first layout into offsets 0x38 through 0x54, lets the second layout overwrite 0x48 through 0x54, and writes fallback offsets 0x58/0x5c/0x60 from 0x38/0x3c/0x40 before the final 0x64 fallback write from effective bottom 0x54.

Iterates the model-id list, selects the current model when palette-item offsets 0x0c and 0x10 are non-empty, creates panel and context services, passes owner as the panel receiver, and grows the 32-bit target-word item vector at 0xe8/0xec/0xf0.
Retains fresh panel and context services, retains the panel in the vector, then releases context before the panel local reference.

Directly stores the application system, retains and configures the swatch manager, hides it, initializes the two application callbacks, and conditionally constructs the advanced application controller using the palette item and owner.

When the selection-entry vector is non-empty, follows the live 0x005c5b39 path by reading the entry model, calling 0x005c2a30 reachability, dividing by the entry divisor, and calling 0x005c2590 before validating and storing the current index. The later 0x005c3a50 call is unreachable in the live path and is not asserted. It then tears down fields 0x18, swatch, and 0x20 with the (1, 0) enabled callback.

evidence.fact: Live pseudocode contains the key-matching branch, service replacement order, layout construction, item loop, swatch setup, application callback pair, advanced branch, and teardown.

RET 0x0c proves three explicit words; instructions at 0x005c55b7 pass palette_item and the owner to 0x005c51e0, and 0x005c57ce-0x005c5804 show both fallback writes including the final 0x64 write from 0x54.
The direct dependency set includes the base layout, swatch, layout, item, and lifecycle helpers represented by the opaque service boundary.

evidence_boundaries: No concrete SDK manager membership is asserted for the common, layout, panel, context, swatch, or advanced services.
The temporary model-id allocator and vector growth helpers remain service operations because their allocator contracts are not established by the seeded body.
The live decompiler reports type-propagation and unreachable-block warnings; raw field offsets and call order take precedence, and the unreachable 0x005c5b9a block is intentionally excluded.
unresolved_contradictions: The decompiler renders several embedded services as IAppSystem pointer types; those aliases are not treated as authoritative ownership.
The target first copies first-layout bottom to 0x64 and then overwrites 0x64 with effective bottom 0x54; the reconstruction preserves both writes.
The exact concrete return types of layout and item factories are not established by the target's undefined prototypes.
